subject: Decision Overturmed! :)
author: ZombieTron
body:
Thanks to a record breaking 3 comments in one day.... an almost unheard of level of activity for the site, it is clear from YOU our fans, that you want us to continue, so we will!

Let's hope EA come to the same conclusion about Revenge!

We love you guys for reading, and love it even more when you post stuff!!

We also quite enjoy the 1st of April, I only wish the domain name was worth what Xandu claims... we probably would sell!! :)
